Would you like to work in a modern warehouse where safety, teamwork, and quality are key? Join Schneider Electric in Helmond as a Production employee. Then this is your chance! Through Adecco, you will be working a steady full-time job at Schneider Electric, a leading international company with a modern, safe, and tightly organized distribution center in Helmond.

What are you going to do?
As a production employee, you are an essential part of the production process. Your work directly contributes to high-quality end products. 

Your duties include:

- Assemble server racks
- Work in a tidy, clean and organized environment with a friendly team of international colleagues
- With your sharp eye for detail and handy skills, you'll build each server rack with great care
- Packaging and preparing orders for shipment
- Working in accordance with strict safety and quality regulations

What do we offer?
- Gross hourly wage of €14,99
- Shift allowance of 8,75% in 2 shifts (then you earn €16,30- per hour)*
- Travel allowance from 5km up to 70km one way (€0,23 per km)
- 30 vacation days
- Potential for a permanent contract based on good performance
- Quarterly bonus based on your performance
- Work in a safe, modern, and clean warehouse with a social team

You will work from Monday to Friday in 1 shift from 6:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

*From week 36 there will be 2 shifts, from 06:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. and from 01:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.

Where will you work?
Schneider Electric is a global specialist in energy management and industrial automation. Customers throughout Europe are served from the distribution center in Helmond. In 2017, the warehouse was named the Safest Warehouse in the Netherlands. Innovation, sustainability, and collaboration are of high importance here.

What do we ask?
- Good command of the English language (speaking and reading)
- Experience in logistics/assembly is a plus
- Availability of 40 hours per week (full-time)
- You live within travel distance
